overview: After Navarre you wrote a page of the tradesmen that is not on Sunday's list. The tailor cannot read and will not be mocked for it. The wall is a man who stands anyway. You did not finish the page, and you did not count the leaves.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page, left it unfinished, and did not count it.

assets.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
assets.disposition: Wrote a page of the hard-handed men

summary: Wrote a page of the hard-handed men
